name: @appstrate/browserless
description: Browserless's MCP server, on Browserless Cloud or on your own instance (its URL is a connection variable): headless browsers for agents. Scrape a page as markdown, HTML, links, a screenshot or a PDF; crawl or map a site; search the web; fetch a page in its native format, optionally zipped with its resources; run a Lighthouse audit or Puppeteer code. On Cloud, also read account usage, sessions and logs, and get a live viewer link. Connect with an API token. A self-hosted open-source Browserless runs only Puppeteer code and the built-in browsing recipes. Cloud calls consume units.

base_url.title: URL du serveur MCP Browserless
base_url.description: Browserless Cloud : gardez https://mcp.browserless.io. Auto-hébergé : adresse du serveur @browserless.io/mcp lancé avec TRANSPORT=httpStream et relié à votre instance par BROWSERLESS_API_URL, sans /mcp.

api_key.title: Jeton d'API
api_key.description: Sur Browserless Cloud, le jeton d'API de votre compte (https://browserless.io/account) : chaque appel consomme ses unités. Sur une instance auto-hébergée, le TOKEN de cette instance.
